name: 60-30-10 Rule
description: A colour-proportion guideline: use a dominant colour for about 60% of a design, a secondary colour for about 30% and an accent colour for about 10%.
design_relevance_note: Used to build balanced palettes for interfaces and brand systems; effectively a default starting ratio.
myth_risk_note: Presented as a principle, but it is a convention with no evidence found that these specific proportions affect perception or outcomes.
